# ASP.NET VB.NET 4.x VRT fixture

This Web Forms page is dynamically compiled as VB.NET by ASP.NET 4.x. It provides a server-side postback action and an optional intentional visual difference:

- `Default.aspx`: blue action button
- `Default.aspx?variant=different`: red action button

It is intended for isolated Windows/IIS integration checks, not production deployment.
